wheree.summary: Customers commend Get Hip Records for its knowledgeable staff, excellent selection of records across multiple genres, and a welcoming environment that encourages exploration. Many appreciate the organized layout which makes finding items easier.
wheree.reliability: Many users highlighted the store's consistent operating hours and accessibility, making it a reliable choice for record shopping.

mapquest.description: Get Hip Records is a prominent record store located in Pittsburgh, PA, specializing in a diverse selection of music, including exclusive releases and imports from various artists and labels.

wikipedia.summary: Get Hip Records is an independent Pittsburgh-based music label and distributor formed by Gregg Kostelich in 1986. Kostelich used the label to release music by his own band, the Cynics, as well as other local, indie and retro garage rock bands.

keyQuotes: I've been accumulating records my whole life and I can't take them to the graveyard, so why not start a record store?
We're gonna have every style of music. I'm not turning my back on jazz or blues. If I have a good enough polka collection, I'll have that for sale too.
We will have the best local section in Pittsburgh.
We love having parties and we love having fun. I just wanna have fucking fun until I die.
keyFacts: Store opened 2017, 31 years after label founding in 1986
Located at 1800 Columbus Ave in Chateau/North Side, near Bicycle Heaven
Store managed by Geoff Leamon, former owner of Left of the Dial Records (Santa Ana, CA)
Staff includes Zack Keim, lead singer of Nox Boys (Get Hip band)
Plans included bi-weekly yoga classes, regular Friday/Saturday concerts in third-floor space
Purchased metal collection from Hits and Misses Records (Toronto/Vancouver)
Opened same month as Skull Records (Allentown) and Vinyl Remains (Dormont)
